channel.title: RedundaNet news
channel.description: Articles, announcements and notes from the RedundaNet project.

item.title: RedundaNet 3.0.0
item.description: RedundaNet 3.0.0 is out: one static binary, identity from a phrase, backups erasure coded across members, weekly restore tests, repair without the owner, self-update with rollback. What changed for members, what is not there yet, and what happens to RedundaNet 2.

item.title: Your backup is someone else's computer. What if it were everyone's?
item.description: Every guide to backups repeats the same rule: three copies, two media, one somewhere else. But what did you actually buy from a cloud provider? Seven principles for storage worth trusting, the story behind a community-run network, and why any organization sitting on idle disks can fork it.
